statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The diagnosis codes submitted were R55 and G45.9
The denial reason code was CO-197
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope
The patient has transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or conduction abnormalities
The service was ordered to evaluate for arrhythmias or conduction abnormalities that may be precipitating syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion
The denial was based on medical necessity grounds
The denial was based on Reason Code CO-197 indicating that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained
